page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m8-vws.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.vgn6i-vws family, virtualized via KVM. It features 10 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 5 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 46.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 4.6 GB per core. Acceleration is provided by a fractional NVIDIA T4 GPU with a 0.5x allocation and 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. No local storage is bundled with this instance, and it maintains a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear division between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core processing is a notable bottleneck, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the weak and poor categories respectively. However, multi-core performance is more robust, achieving average ratings in stress-ng multi-core, Passmark CPU, and software compilation tests. Memory bandwidth remains average for both cached and uncached operations, though Passmark memory scores are weak.

Given the fractional GPU and moderate CPU performance, this instance represents a cost-efficient entry point for workloads requiring hardware acceleration without the expense of a full dedicated GPU. It is suited for entry-level GPU-accelerated tasks such as light image processing, ray tracing, and small-scale LLM inference. However, it is poorly suited for larger models like 7B parameter LLMs or single-thread-heavy tasks due to the observed performance degradation in those areas.
